C0821.title: IC3 Alert: Cybercriminals Exploit Credential Stuffing and Phishing to Steal Business Accounts
C0821.summary: The FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center issued an account takeover fraud warning explaining that cybercriminals can obtain employee login credentials through brute forcing, phishing emails, and similar methods, then take over corporate bank, payroll, or health savings accounts. Such attacks can result in wages or corporate funds being redirected to attacker-controlled accounts and cause direct financial losses, highlighting the need for abnormal login monitoring, credential protection, and payment-change review.
